verdict.rationale: Ramp ships an official open-source CLI built for headless automation. Its `--agent` mode outputs JSON (the default when piped), `--no-input` disables prompts for CI, and standalone agents authenticate without a browser via OAuth client credentials (RAMP_CLIENT_ID/RAMP_CLIENT_SECRET), with RAMP_PROFILE pinning an identity for automation. Client-credentials server-to-server API access and a sandbox environment for safe testing round this out. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of running it in a real CI pipeline, and concrete CI-platform examples (e.g. a sample pipeline config).
